description: One call with the inputs for holding STANDARD on The Standard Reserve (TSR) on Robinhood Chain. Returns the policy outlook, issuance runway, pending governance changes, tax schedule, buyback readiness and dormancy state. summary is a flat map of the headline numbers. Each part comes back under parts.<name> with its own status (ok, not_ready, or error); one part failing never fails the whole call. Dormancy carries the reportable wallet count, not the full list; the count is null until the dormancy window has been read from chain. It returns inputs only and does not recommend an action. Takes no arguments.
name: 1s_std_decision_hold
title: TSR Decision: Hold
